collection.title: Mitsubishi Outlander Van 2013 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mitsubishi Outlander Van 2013 to 2019 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
